title: MCPiler Manifest credentials section
description: Credential declarations carrying references, never secret material.

id.$comment: Upper case is refused rather than folded, so two ids can never differ only by case.
id.description: Identifies this credential for an execution binding's credentialRef. Carries no other runtime meaning and is never a secret.

scheme.$comment: 'none' appears in Studio doc comments but matches no applier branch, so admitting it here would describe a silent no-op as a configuration.

slot.description: basic: 'username' or 'password'. bearer: the header name. apiKey/header: the header, query or cookie name.

location.description: Meaningful for apiKey only; defaults to header.

reference.description: Exactly one variant. 'inline' is refused unless Engine is started with the explicit opt-in.
